credits:
All songs Written and Produced by Bells Atlas 
Artwork by Sophie Roach 
Graphic Design by Erica Fink

"Future Bones" and "Bling" mixed/co-produced by Akiyoshi Ehara
"Sugar for the Queen" and "Mess it Up" mixed by Jacob Winik
Engineered by Jacob Winik and Bijan Sharifi

Many thanks for the support and love of our friends and family, to our wonderful community of fellow musicians who are doing so many awesome things, to the team at Zoo Labs for believing in us & encouraging us do our thing, the city of Oakland for constant inspiration and vitality, and most of all to you our fans for being so beautifully awesome, reaching out, sharing your experiences with us and bringing your wonderful faces to our shows!
